lines.text: Amos says woe to those at ease in Zion, and sends them to Calneh, Hamath and Gath.
They lie on ivory beds, dine on lambs and stall-fed calves, and play the harp like Moses.
They drink wine by the bowlful but do not grieve over Joseph's ruin, so they will go into exile first.
The Lord GOD swears He abhors Jacob's pride and will deliver up the city, and a man answers "None."
They boast of taking Karnaim by their own strength, but the LORD will raise up a king against them from Lebo-hamath to the Brook of the Arabah.
